title: HSK2 Gate 19 · Ming Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 19: Ming Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第19关：明朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 六百多年以前，明朝有一个很大的船队。带船队的人叫郑和。他的船非常大，比很多房子还大。一条船上可以住几百个人。
passageEn: More than six hundred years ago, the Ming had a great fleet. The man who led the fleet was called Zheng He. His ships were enormous, bigger than many houses. One ship could hold several hundred people.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than six hundred years ago, the Ming had a great fleet.
comprehension.answer: 六百多年以前，明朝有一个很大的船队。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: His ships were enormous, bigger than many houses.
comprehension.answer: 他的船非常大，比很多房子还大。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 多 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“多”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 多 (duō) means "more than" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “多”（duō）的意思是“more than”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 年 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“年”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 年 (nián) means "years" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “年”（nián）的意思是“years”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: Long, long ago, it rained in China for many days, and a great flood came.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
More than six hundred years ago, the Ming had a great fleet.

check.explanationEn: "六百多年以前，明朝有一个很大的船队。" means "More than six hundred years ago, the Ming had a great fleet.".
check.explanation: “六百多年以前，明朝有一个很大的船队。”的意思是“More than six hundred years ago, the Ming had a great fleet.”。
